{{Quote|Stormtroopers. They're flanking the mouth of the tunnel. It looks like an entire platoon. They must know we're coming.|Din Djarin, to the rest of his companions|<ref name="Chapter 8" />}}
A '''platoon''' of [[stormtrooper]]s and [[scout trooper]]s were part of a [[Gideon's battalion|battalion]] led by [[Moff]] [[Gideon]] when on [[Nevarro]]. During the [[clash on Nevarro]]<ref name="Chapter 8" /> in [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> after the main fighting in the [[Nevarro City|city]] concluded, the [[platoon]] positioned themselves outside the mouth of a [[Magma|lava river]]. The platoon was wiped out when [[IG-11]] sacrificed itself in an explosion.<ref name="Chapter 8" />

{{Military-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The platoon first appeared in "[[Chapter 8: Redemption]]" and was confirmed to be a platoon by the episode's descriptive audio.<ref name="Chapter 8" />
